Alice M.: Heads-up: scheduled maintenance this Saturday 2026-04-04 02:00-03:00 UTC. We'll run a planned DB primary failover + kernel updates on infra hosts in us-west-2. Expect brief (<60s) connection drops for some long-lived streams. No data loss expected. Please avoid deploying migrations during the window.

Ben K.: Will Dedicated customers on reserved capacity be impacted? Any SLA blips we should expect?

Carlos (oncall): We'll do a staging canary then a 10% prod canary to a secondary region. Monitor replication lag and p99. SLOs should hold but we'll track everything. If we see >2min sustained errors we'll halt and rollback.

Dana S.: Please add a banner on status.redwood and the Scheduled Maintenance page. I can trigger an accounts email once you confirm the exact window text.

infra-bot: Scheduled job created: maintenance/window/1778123456 (owner: Carlos). Link: https://internal-runbooks.redwood/ops/1778123456

Eve R.: Which dashboards should we watch? CPU, replication lag, 99th latency, KV cache hit rate?

Carlos (oncall): Watch these panels: ReplicationLag (db.replica.lag_ms), api.p99_latency, redis.kv_hit_rate. I'll pin a Grafana view. Canary plan:

Carlos (oncall): ```
# Canary plan
- step 0: staging failover (validate)
- step 1: canary -> route 10% prod traffic to secondary for 15m
- step 2: evaluate metrics (lag < 50ms, p99 delta < +20ms, errors ~ baseline)
- step 3: ramp to 50% then 100% if green
rollback: route 100% back to primary, restart proxies, demote replica if needed
commands:
kubectl exec -n infra db-router -- curl -XPOST "/failover?target=secondary"
```

Ben K.: If rollback needed, how long to restore primary? Do we need provider support for promotion?

Carlos (oncall): Typical restore path using our promote script is ~5-10m. Provider support only required if the replica is on failing hardware. Oncall rota: Carlos and Eve will be primary responders.

Alice M.: Quick note: avoid running large batch jobs 1 hour before and after the window.

Dana S.: I'll schedule the banner + customer email. Ping me in this thread once the canary completes.

Carlos (oncall): I'll post the full runbook link in 30m and start at 02:00 UTC. I'll update this thread with pass/fail checks as we progress. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled 30m before start for maintenance/window/1778123456

Eve R.: ack, I'll watch dashboards and be ready to rollback if metrics deviate.
